title: Quina 7130: Contest with Estimated Prize of 12.3 Million
seoTitle: Quina 7130: Contest with Estimated Prize of 12.3 Million
subtitle: Understand what happens in draw 7130 and how prize division works
excerpt: Quina contest 7130, held on September 29, has an estimated prize of 12.3 million reais. Learn how the amounts are distributed and what led to this.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the evening of September 29, Caixa Econômica Federal held Quina draw 7130, with a main prize estimated at 12.3 million reais. The high value and the proximity of the contest attracted significant attention from bettors.

How Quina Prize Division Works

The gross prize corresponds to 43.79% of the contest's collection. Of these funds, 35% are allocated to those who match five numbers, 15% to those who match four numbers, 10% to those who match three, and 10% to those who match two numbers. If there are no winners in a certain tier, the amount rolls over to the first tier of the next contest.

Betting Options and Costs

To play, bettors choose 5 to 15 numbers from 80 available. The minimum price for a basic 5-number bet is R$ 3.00. Marking more numbers increases the cost and the chances of winning. Available features include Surpresinha, which generates random numbers, Teimosinha, which repeats the same bet in consecutive contests, and syndicates (bolões), which allow group bets starting from R$ 15.00, with shares starting from R$ 4.00.

Previous Contest Result (7129) and Rollover

In contest 7129, held on September 28, a syndicate from Cambé, Paraná, matched four out of five numbers, generating 50 winning bets that received R$ 9,298.90 each. No bettor matched all numbers, and the prize rolled over to the next draw, increasing the estimated value of contest 7130.

Prize Claim Deadline

Winners have 90 days, counting from the draw date, to claim their prizes. After this period, unclaimed amounts are transferred to the National Treasury and allocated to the Student Financing Fund (FIES).

Expectations for Contest 7130

With a main prize of 12.3 million reais and the prize distribution details still pending, contest 7130 is generating thousands of bets across the country. The combination of high value, multiple prize tiers, and collective betting options keeps Quina as one of the most sought-after lotteries by Brazilians.

With information from G1, Estadão.
